### Areas Not Covered

No actionable findings are supported. Applied all four Python checklists and checked input handling, boundary cases, error propagation, security, performance, responsibility boundaries, and removal candidates. Trimming occurs before `transport.put`; existing empty-name behavior and transport response forwarding remain consistent.

The parent reports all four unit tests passed, plus six additional client-to-payload cases covering padded names, internal spaces, empty/whitespace-only names, tabs/newlines, Unicode whitespace, and response forwarding. I inspected the tests but did not execute them in this review role.

Repository evidence supports local correctness. The tests use an in-memory transport, so they do not verify a real `/settings` service, its validation policy, or deployment configuration. Accepted non-string inputs are undocumented; no repository caller demonstrates such inputs, so their changed behavior does not substantiate a regression finding.

Both required Capy searches returned an empty knowledge base. No prior findings or project-specific Python idioms were available.
